paper_title: MathOdyssey Benchmarking Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills in Large   Language Models Using Odyssey Math Data
caption: There are three answer-types: True-False questions, Multiple-Choice questions and Open-Answer questions.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of answer types within a dataset, specifically showing the proportions of True-False, Multiple-Choice, and Open-Answer questions. The chart consists of three slices. The “Open-Answer” slice is green and represents 63.0% of the total. “Multiple-Choice” is represented by an orange slice, comprising 32.8% of the data. Finally, "True-False" is indicated by a blue slice, totaling 4.1%. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, moving clockwise. A legend identifying the answer types is included below the chart.
